notablePrerequisites:
Infinite Reflection attached to Composite Golem.
You have a creature card in hand or in your graveyard that has a cycling ability and can be cast using {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
You are able to cast the creature card.
description:
Cast the creature card with cycling either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying its mana cost, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Composite Golem.
Activate the creature by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
If you cast the creature from your graveyard, it is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing the creature's cycling ability.
Repeat.
If the creature has mana value 4 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.
